Bay Mau Coconut Forest, a popular attraction near Hoi An, is famous for its unique bamboo basket boat experience. This article provides useful tips on renting basket boats at affordable prices, the ideal time to visit, local specialties, and practical notes for your trip in 2026.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest has become an increasingly popular tourist destination, attracting a large number of visitors. Traveling to Bay Mau Coconut Forest in Hoi An in the summer of 2026 promises unforgettable experiences, especially the chance to explore the area by traditional basket boat. So how can you rent a basket boat at a reasonable price? Let’s explore the answer together with Vietlook Travel in the article below.

Da Nang Travel: Affordable Basket Boat Rental at Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Where Is Bay Mau Coconut Forest Located?

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is a well-known tourist attraction located in Cam Thanh Commune, Hoi An City, Quang Nam Province. It lies only about 3 km southeast of Hoi An Ancient Town, making it very convenient for visitors to travel and explore. Thanks to this prime location, Bay Mau Coconut Forest is an ideal destination to combine with a Hoi An sightseeing itinerary.

This vast water coconut forest is situated at the confluence of the Co Co River and Thu Bon River, forming a unique mangrove ecosystem. Since ancient times, it has provided abundant aquatic resources and acted as a natural shield protecting local residents from floods and storms. Today, Bay Mau Coconut Forest not only plays an important environmental role but also attracts visitors with its untouched beauty and distinctive Central Vietnamese river culture.

The Origin of the Name “Bay Mau Coconut Forest”

The name “Bay Mau Coconut Forest” originates from the forest’s original size. In the 18th century, the forest covered only about seven mẫu (approximately 70,000 square meters). However, thanks to favorable natural conditions such as brackish water and a tropical monsoon climate, water coconut trees thrived and gradually expanded to an area of over 100 hectares.

Despite its significant expansion, the name “Bay Mau” has been preserved by locals and visitors as a way to honor the forest’s history and long-standing connection with the land. More than just a number, the name carries cultural value and reflects the early days when the coconut forest was first formed and became a symbol of the Cam Thanh river region.

What’s Attractive About a Bay Mau Coconut Forest Tour?

Bay Mau Coconut Forest resembles a miniature version of the Mekong Delta right in the heart of Central Vietnam. Visitors are immersed in a refreshing green space of endless water coconut trees stretching along small canals. The highlight experience here is riding a basket boat, a traditional means of transportation used by local fishermen.

Sitting on a basket boat, you’ll be skillfully guided through narrow waterways, enjoying the peaceful atmosphere while discovering the area’s rich ecosystem.

In addition, visitors can watch impressive basket boat spinning performances by local artisans. The skillful spinning and balancing techniques on the small round boats are sure to amaze you. You may also try rowing a basket boat yourself under the guidance of locals an unforgettable hands-on experience.

Other activities include learning how to make handicrafts from coconut leaves (rings, hats, watches), participating in folk games on the water such as basket boat racing, tug-of-war, or fishing. These activities offer a wonderful chance to connect with local life and explore the unique river culture of Hoi An.

Best Time to Visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest

The ideal time to visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest is during the dry season, from February to September. During this period, the weather in Hoi An is usually sunny, dry, and pleasant—perfect for outdoor activities like basket boat rides and sightseeing.

The best months are March to May, when temperatures are mild and comfortable. If you enjoy lively atmospheres and traditional festivals, consider visiting during major holidays or on full-moon days (lunar calendar) to combine your trip with a nighttime visit to Hoi An Ancient Town.

If you prefer a quieter experience, it’s best to visit on weekdays and avoid peak midday hours.

Local Cuisine at Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Visiting Bay Mau Coconut Forest is not only about nature but also about food. Restaurants and small eateries around the area serve a variety of fresh seafood, including fish, shrimp, crabs, and snails caught locally.

You shouldn’t miss dishes made from water coconut, such as coconut salad, coconut sweet soup, and fresh coconut drinks. After the forest tour, you can also enjoy famous Hoi An specialties like Mi Quang, Cao Lau, banh vac (white rose dumplings), and wontons.

How to Get to Bay Mau Coconut Forest

There are several ways to travel from Hoi An city center to Bay Mau Coconut Forest:

  • Motorbike: The most popular and flexible option, allowing you to enjoy scenic views along the way. Travel time is about 10–15 minutes.

  • Bicycle: Ideal for those who enjoy a peaceful pace and fresh air. The route is short and flat.

  • Taxi or Grab: A comfortable option for families or groups with children.

  • Boat: Some tours offer boat transfers from Hoi An Ancient Town to the coconut forest, providing a unique experience from the start.

Basket Boat Rental Prices at Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Basket boat rides are a must-do activity at Bay Mau Coconut Forest. Current prices (updated 2025) are as follows:

  • Entrance ticket: 30,000 VND per person

  • Basket boat ride: Approximately 200,000 – 250,000 VND per boat (maximum 2 adults and 1 child)

Prices may vary slightly depending on the season and your bargaining skills.

On average, the total cost per person ranges from 130,000 – 155,000 VND if two people share a boat—quite reasonable for such a unique experience.

Tips for Renting Basket Boats Cheaply and Effectively

  • Travel in groups: Sharing a basket boat helps reduce costs significantly.

  • Book online in advance: Many travel agencies offer combo packages at better prices. Booking at least one day ahead is recommended.

  • Avoid buying tickets directly at the entrance: Prices are often higher and harder to negotiate.

  • Choose off-peak times: Visit on weekdays or early morning/late afternoon for fewer crowds and better deals.

  • Ask about included services: Some tours include performances, handicraft activities, or local food—make sure you get full value.

Other Important Notes When Visiting Bay Mau Coconut Forest

  • Clothing: Wear comfortable, breathable clothes and easy-to-walk footwear. Bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

  • Environmental protection: Keep the area clean and avoid damaging plants or littering.

  • Bring a camera: The lush green scenery is perfect for photos—don’t miss it.

  • Interact with locals: Local people are friendly and welcoming. Talking with them will enrich your experience.

In conclusion, Vietlook Travel has shared detailed information about Bay Mau Coconut Forest, including affordable basket boat rental tips and essential travel notes. We hope these insights will help make your upcoming Da Nang – Hoi An tour more memorable and enjoyable, offering truly unique and meaningful experiences.
